name: app-lavender-meal-planner-with-brand-profile-and-macro-rings
title: Three white screens on lavender: brand profile grid, weekly meal plan with pastel macro cards, and recipe detail with rings
whatItIs: Three phones on a lavender gradient: a brand profile with pill tabs, search and a 3x3 grid of brand logos with three selected, a home with a purple progress card and ring, tinted macro cards (lilac, mint, peach), a date strip with check marks and a meal plan list, and a recipe with a photo, stat chips, three ring cards and tabs.
whatItMeans: Friendly and clear; pastel colour-coded cards make nutrition data feel gentle.
techniques: Colour-code macros with three pastel tints.
Use ring charts inside tinted cards.
Show a week as a check-mark strip.

vocabulary.definition: A tinted card showing a nutrient value.
A row of days with completion marks.
Brand logos with highlighted chosen ones.
